newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Aerolineas Argentinas, AMR talk code sharing.
newsitem.headline: Aerolineas Argentinas, AMR talk code sharing.

text.p: Aerolineas Argentinas said Friday it was holding talks with AMR Corp's American Airlines and other carriers on a possible code sharing deal.

"This would permit us, if we close a deal, to connect with cities that we do not serve. For example, we could have access to domestic routes in Asia, Europe and the United States," said a spokesman for Aerolineas.
Code sharing allows the airlines involved to issue tickets on their own systems for flights with partner airlines.

Spanish state-owned airline Iberia Lineas Aereas de Espana SA holds a 20 percent stake in Aerolineas, while the Spanish government itself owns around 45 percent through its 100 percent ownership of Iberia and through a holding company.
